title: Isolation of Intestinal Organoids from Matrigel for Protein or RNA Extraction
author: rachel.bates Bates
materials: Intestinal organoids are grown in 30 µL Cultrex® 3-D Culture Matrix™ Reduced Growth Factor Basement Membrane Extract, PathClear® Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #3445-001-01 domes for 240:00:00
Once organoids are large enough for harvest domes are washed three times with ice cold Phosphate Buffered Saline Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #28374 .

steps.title: Add Cell Recovery solution
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Cell Recovery Solution (Corning Catalog #354253) to each well, then incubate on ice for 1 hour with orbital shaking at 100 rpm at 4 °C.

steps.title: Harvest, wash, and incubate organoids
steps.instruction: Transfer the well contents to a centrifuge tube, centrifuge at 6000 rpm for 1 min (temperature not specified), carefully discard the supernatant, add 1 mL ice‑cold PBS (4 °C), and incubate on ice for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Harvest well contents into a centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 6000 rpm for 1 min (temperature not specified).

steps.title: Final centrifugation and pellet collection
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6000 rpm, 4 °C for 1 min, then carefully remove the supernatant and as much solidified Matrigel as possible, leaving the organoid pellet ready for RNA or protein extraction.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant and residual solidified Matrigel, leaving the organoid pellet.
Proceed to RNA or protein extraction.
